marco.partnerships: Quick sync  aligning SI onboarding handoff with HW partner and Marketplace listing. Need a short mentor-run checklist, voucher rules, and marketing approval cadence. Who can own which piece?

lena.enablement: I can own the mentor checklist + one-pager brief. Suggest 3 checkpoints: kit delivered, sandbox provisioned, proctored demo passed. Will draft by Wed.

owen.hw-partner: HW side will fund 15 vouchers. Prefer hosted sandboxes for telemetry, but offline kits OK. Marketing requests embargo until 8 certified SIs. Will confirm in email.

sophia.ops: Note on sandboxes: hosted provisioning is 48h and Dedicated seats must be reserved. I'll open CAP-14000 to reserve 20 seats and tag this thread.

tim.training: Offline ZIP facilitator bundle is ready (slides, labs, proctor checklist). Proctor flow: recorded demo + 10m live Q&A; pass = successful end-to-end deploy + metadata submission. Happy to draft SOP.

infra-bot: Reminder  Dedicated maintenance Sun 03:00 UTC may affect provisioning windows.

marco.partnerships: Ownership recap: Lena -> checklist & mentor brief; Sophia -> CAP-14000/reservations; Owen -> voucher confirmation & marketing threshold; Tim -> offline kit + proctor SOP. I'll draft partner email and loop legal for recording consent. Thanks all.
